REEVE ALEUTIAN AIRWAYS, INC.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR OUR PASSENGERS
What to do in case of a water landing:
Your Flight Attendant will help you with the following
1. Put out cigarettes immediately. Put your
seat back and tray table in the full upright
position.
2. Remove high heeled shoes and cumbersorie
clothing. Loosen your collar and tie. Remove
things that might hurt you, such as eyeglasses,
pens and sharp objects.
3. Take your life vest out of the pouch
underneath your seat, remove it from the
plastic bag, and put it on. (See below) Do NOT
inflate it.
4. Sit down and fasten your seat belt TIGHT
and LOW. Locate the emergency exits nearest
your seat and know how to open them (see
other side).
5. A short time before landing you will receive
a "Brace" signal. Of the two Brace Positions
shown below, use the one that is best suited
for the amount of room at your seat. This is
IMPORTANT, to reduce the shock of sudden
deceleration.
6. AFTER ALL MOTION HAS STOPPED,
unfasten your seatbelt and go quickly to the
nearest useable exit. Crew members will direct
you to rafts.
DO NOT INFLATE VEST INSIDE THE AIRPLANE
1. Take vest out of underseat
pouch
and
remove
from
plastic bag. Put vest on over
your head with bulky section
in front.
2. Pass strap to the side,
around the back, to the front
and fasten. Pull strap to
tighten.
3. Inflate AFTER leaving the
aircraft by jerking down on
two toggles at the bottom.
For added buoyancy, blow
into tubes at the top.
Crew members will be identified by pink or orange vests.
This aircraft is in constant radio contact with Company and FAA radio stations. In the event
of an emergency, Search and Rescue operations will be put into action immediately.
BRACE POSITIONS
Use this position if you don't have
enough room for the other.
ELECTRONIC DEVICES -
Federal Aviation Regulations permit ONLY the following electronic
devices to be operated aboard Reeve Aleutian Airways aircraft: heart
pacemakers, hearing aids, electric shavers, and portable voice recorders.
NOTE: Operation of portable radios is NOT allowed by R.A.A.
PLEASE DO NOT REMOVE THIS CARD FROM AIRPLANE
2002127.496

located nearest your seat and how to open them.
